name: Peat Cutter Hamish

intro.text: Three hundred blocks a day, if the weather's kind. You'll excuse me if I swing a bit hard.

win: I've been knocked flatter by a good gale. Well done.
after: Peat takes thousands of years to form, and the banks the islanders cut have been growing since the last ice age. The cuttings are small and the islands are careful.
